relationship: One proposed meeting instant has different local clock and date representations, and it works only if its full duration fits every participant's availability.

learnerLoop.action: Place or calculate an organiser start time, send the proposal and inspect each local calendar.
learnerLoop.modelChange: The single meeting is converted into participant local times and dates.
learnerLoop.evidence: Linked calendars, fixed UTC offsets and availability checks show whether everyone can attend.
learnerLoop.nextDecision: Shift the organiser time or justify the conflict or valid overlap.

invariants: All displayed local times refer to the same meeting instant.
A valid meeting must fit every attendee's entire duration, including date changes.
safeAdaptations: Vary fixed offsets, availability windows and meeting durations.
Adjust calculation support while retaining simultaneous local-calendar evidence.
nonGoals: Geographic time-zone lookup or daylight-saving rule modelling.

task.description: Current organiser request, attendee duration and meeting token.
task.visibility: Shown for the current generated timetable problem.

model.description: Linked local-time calendars, availability windows and placed/sent meeting blocks. One full-width calendar-and-working layout. The meeting token sits above the organiser calendar, below the goal; calculation support and proposal gates retain their existing meanings.
model.visibility: Present throughout. None permits calendar placement; Some/All use the calculated organiser start and keep linked calendars visible.

working.description: Offset shifts, converted availability windows, latest starts, common overlap and final-start calculation.
working.visibility: None reveals the supplied method after a successful proposal, with compact method steps beforehand. Some/All show the selected calculation fields and supplied reference values.

evidence.description: Calendar placements, sent meeting blocks, attendee fit/conflict summary and typed-start feedback show feasibility.
evidence.visibility: Summary changes after placing or sending; typed status exists in calculate mode.

completion.description: Accepted timetable and next request/working upgrade.
completion.visibility: Shown only when every attendee fits the duration and the selected working checks pass.

settings.description: One grey Working: None / Some / All toggle, reset and send.
settings.visibility: Always available; there is no separate method toggle.

inputs.description: Organizer placement or typed start and generated calculation slots.
inputs.visibility: Token dragging is available in guided mode; typed and calculation slots are generated for calculate mode.

meeting-start.description: One organiser-local start instant for the fixed meeting duration.
meeting-start.domain: Date and local clock time; may cross a date boundary in another city.
meeting-start.source: Dragged #meetingToken or typed #typedDate/#typedHour/#typedMinute; final calculation fields use finalStart.
meeting-start.output: Organizer meeting block, #summary and sent blocks.

duration.description: Whole meeting duration that must fit every attendee's availability.
duration.output: Meeting block width and fits/overlap checks.

offset-shifts.description: Organiser minus participant UTC offset differences for local-clock conversion.
offset-shifts.source: Fixed city offsets in the source; generated shift work entries.
offset-shifts.output: #calcContent shift fields and converted participant times.

converted-windows.description: Participant availability starts/ends expressed against the organiser reference date/time.
converted-windows.source: Fixed availability windows plus offset conversion.
converted-windows.output: Calendar availability, converted-window work fields and sent fit checks.

common-window.description: Latest valid start for each attendee and intersection commonLo/commonHi.
common-window.source: Converted availability ends minus duration, then max starts/min latest starts.

modes.none: None (data-work-level=0) retains calendar placement. Send a proposal to inspect participant responses; the full supplied method appears after a successful proposal.
modes.some: Some (data-work-level=2) requires shift2, conv2s, latest2, commonHi and finalStart. Matching reference calculations remain supplied.
modes.all: All (data-work-level=4) requires shift1/2, conv1s/e, conv2s/e, latest0/1/2, commonLo/Hi and finalStart.
modes.scope: Fixed city offsets and explicit availability windows; DST/geographic lookup is outside the model.

dependencies: A proposal is accepted only when its entire duration fits every attendee; Some/All also require every selected work key and finalStart to pass.
The single Working toggle owns placement versus calculation support. Changing levels clears the current attempt, preserving the existing reset semantics.
The Send proposal action stores the meeting blocks; valid timetable and working together enable the completion card.
After two successes, None may offer Try some working and Some may offer Try all working. Availability checks and day rollover remain identical.
implementation.completion: The source shows #nextCard when timetableSuccess and workingReady are both true; timetableSuccess requires every attendee's full duration to fit, while guided workingReady is true and calculate checks its selected fields.
limitations: Offsets are fixed constants; there is no DST, geographic lookup or timezone-rule calculation.
Internal helper state retains guided/calculate and numeric 2/4 identifiers; the learner-facing settings expose only None/Some/All.
